title: Componentwise normalization of a scheme
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. For each irreducible component $Z$ [def-weil-irreducible-components], give $Z$ its reduced induced closed subscheme structure [def-pc-reduced-scheme], defined by the vanishing ideal of $Z$. This scheme is integral. Define $X^
u$ to be the disjoint union, indexed by these components, of their function-field normalizations [def-sc-normalization]. The canonical map $
u:X^
u	o X$ restricts on each summand to the normalization map followed by the closed inclusion of the component. The empty scheme gives the empty disjoint union.
